event.title: Chao Phraya floods · Sep–Oct 2026
event.subtitle: Ayutthaya · Pathum Thani · northern Bangkok
event.context: A depression flooded Bangkok and central Thailand from 24 to 30 Sep 2026 (Wikipedia: 2026 Bangkok floods). Chao Phraya Dam releases then pushed the river beyond embankments in Ayutthaya, and officials warned of further rises from northern runoff on 4 Oct (Khaosod English; Thai PBS World).
event.caveat: Central Thailand is intensively irrigated rice land; standing water in paddies before 20 Sep is treated as normal, so mapped flood is water that is new since then. Dense Bangkok streets are beyond what radar can map.

validation.protocol: Model trained in Assam plus ONE automatically labelled Thailand scene (7 Oct); scored on 19 Oct, which it never saw. Reference: Sentinel-2 cloud-free open water, same day.
